messages.subject: Re: Combining multiple grids for a secr.fit model
parts:
Hi Lauren
When the likelihood cannot be evaluated, as shown by the NA values for logLik, there must be something fundamentally wrong that we cannot see. This can happen when the starting values are way off, but I don't know if that's what's happening here. Not sure how you have set this up, but I think what you need is a sessioncov that has one value for all treatment groups and another for the control.
Murray
